name: BADM 3401
title: Business Software Development
description: (Also offered as OPIM 3401.) This course introduces students to the development of computer software for business information processing. Topics include flowcharting, pseudocode, programming with a business-oriented computer language, file processing concepts, and on-line and batch processing. Formerly offered as OPIM 3220.
requirement_description: Open only to non-business majors of junior or higher status.
